title: Personal Credit Cards: Recording a Card Closure and the Autopay Option It Keeps
content:
A Personal Credit Cards account is closed by its cardholder's own confirmation, and the same confirmation fixes which automatic payment option the closed card keeps.

## How a closure is recorded

The agent registers no separate closure request. The cardholder's confirmation made on the card account is itself the record of the closure, and the account is closed from the moment of that confirmation, never sooner.

## Points at the moment of closing

A closure recorded this way costs the cardholder no points that could have been paid out in cash. When the confirmation takes effect, any unredeemed points still on the card are ones that no cash-out could take, either because they fall short of the tier's smallest redemption or because the cardholder has no active PCB checking account to receive them. Such points are forfeited with the closure, and their presence never prevents the cardholder from closing.

## Confirming the closure

Only the cardholder can confirm. The agent unlocks the customer tool `confirm_card_closure_806ea607` and hands it to the cardholder, and the customer themselves confirms with it. A confirmation sets the card account to closed, with the day of confirmation as the closing date, and sets its automatic payment option to the value supplied. Any money still owed remains payable, and the card can no longer be used; the cardholder sees the card as closed straight away.

| Parameter | Meaning | Values |
|---|---|---|
| `card_account_id` | the credit card account being closed, from the card account lookup | identifier |
| `autopay_option` | the automatic payment option that remains on the closed card | `none` (no automatic payment continues), `minimum_due` (the minimum payment keeps being debited until the balance is paid), `statement_balance` (the full statement balance keeps being debited until the balance is paid), `fixed_amount` (the fixed sum already on the card keeps being debited until the balance is paid) |

## Receipt

The tool answers with `status` "closed", `card_account_id`, `closed_date` (the day of confirmation, YYYY-MM-DD) and `autopay_option`, the option left on the closed card. The closure is complete when that answer is returned.
